source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of kidney stones and their treatment (PDF 19-20).

blocks.text: Peshab ki pathriyan (urinary stones) sakht, qalmi (crystalline) maadni zarre hain jo aapas mein jur kar gurde ya peshab ke raste mein chhote "kankar" ban jate hain. Yeh gurdon mein reh sakti hain ya peshab ke raste se jism se bahar nikal sakti hain.

Gurde ki pathri ke 70% mareezon mein calcium oxalate ki pathri hoti hai. Yeh pathriyan hypercalciuria (peshab mein zyada calcium) aur hyperoxaluria (peshab mein zyada oxalate) ki wajah se banti hain. 10% mareezon mein uric acid ki pathri ho sakti hai; is ki wajah hyperuricemia (khoon mein zyada uric acid) hai. Peshab mein cystine aur phosphates ki zyada miqdar se bhi pathriyan banti hain. Jism mein lagataar pani ki kami (dehydration) pathri banne ka imkan barha deti hai. Pathri ka ilaj aam taur par lithotripsy se hota hai, yaani pathri ko torna. Lithotripsy ke do tareeqe hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab yahan 'cysteine' likhti hai. Pathri banane wala madda cystine hai: do cysteine molecules jur kar cystine banate hain, jo pani mein mushkil se ghulta hai aur peshab mein crystals bana leta hai (cystine stones).

blocks.title: Tidbit (dilchasp baat)
blocks.text:
Doctor mareez ke peshab ka test dekh kar pathri ki qism ka andaza lagate hain.
Peshab tezabi (acidic) ho to pathri calcium oxalate ki hoti hai.
Peshab alkaline ho to pathri calcium phosphate ki hoti hai.
Peshab hamesha (persistently) tezabi rahe to pathri uric acid ki hoti hai.

Extracorporeal Shockwave Lithotripsy (ECSWL) mein lithotripter naam ka aala mareez ke jism ke bahar se shockwaves (dabao ki tez lehren) bhejta hai. Yeh shockwaves pathri ko chhote tukron mein tor deti hain. Zyada tar tukre phir peshab ke saath bahar nikal jate hain.

blocks.alt: Mareez sahare se tek laga kar baitha hai aur jism ke bahar lithotripter gurde ki taraf shockwaves bhejta hai. Do bare daire gurda dikhate hain: pehle mein shockwaves renal pelvis ki pathri (stone) tak pahunchti hain; doosre mein pathri chhote tukron mein toot chuki hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 14.5: Extracorporeal shockwave lithotripsy (kitab ki Figure 14.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Lithotripter, Shockwaves (jism ke paas aur pehle daire mein), Stones, Smaller pieces of stones.

blocks.text: Bari pathriyon ke liye Percutaneous Nephrolithotripsy (PNL) istemal hoti hai. Is tareeqe mein mareez ki kamar se gurde tak ek tube dali jati hai. Pathri dekhne ke liye tube ke andar se nephroscope naam ka chhota camera dala jata hai. Phir pathri torne ke liye ultrasound ka aala andar dala jata hai. Pathri ke tukre khaas auzaron se pakar kar gurde se bahar nikal liye jate hain.

blocks.alt: Kamar ka kata hua hissa aur gurda. Aik nali (tube) bahar se jild (skin) ke andar renal pelvis tak jati hai; ureter ke shuru mein pathri pari hai. Lachakdar lakeer nali ko jism ke bahar nephroscope se jorti hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 14.6: Percutaneous Nephrolithotripsy (kitab ki Figure 14.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Renal pelvis, Stone, Skin, Tube, Nephroscope.

blocks.caption: Gurde ki pathri ki qismein
rows: hypercalciuria (peshab mein zyada calcium) aur hyperoxaluria (peshab mein zyada oxalate)

blocks.prompt: Aik mareez ka peshab har test mein tezabi rehta hai. Kaunsi pathri ka imkan zyada hai, aur aam taur par pathri ka khatra kya barhata hai?
blocks.explanation: Uric acid ki pathri, jo khoon mein zyada uric acid (hyperuricemia) se judi hai. Musalsal pani ki kami har pathri ka khatra barhati hai.

items: Pathriyan: calcium oxalate (70%; hypercalciuria, hyperoxaluria), uric acid (10%; hyperuricemia), cystine aur phosphates; pani ki kami khatra barhati hai.
Peshab ka test: tezabi = calcium oxalate, alkaline = calcium phosphate, hamesha tezabi = uric acid.
Ilaj (lithotripsy): ECSWL (bahar se shockwaves) aur bari pathri ke liye PNL (kamar se tube, nephroscope, ultrasound).
